profile.summaryJa: センナケリブが礼拝中に、シャレゼルとアドラムメレクは彼を剣で打ちました。
profile.identityNoteJa: アドラムメレクとともに名が挙がるセンナケリブの子です。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: As he was worshiping in the house of Nisroch his god, Adrammelech and Sharezer struck him with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Ararat. Esar Haddon his son reigned in his place.
